# linearctl comment

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill-docs.py from --help; do not edit. -->

## linearctl comment create

```
Add a Markdown comment to an issue.

--yes requires --id, a UUID you choose, so a rerun can never post twice: if a
comment with that id exists, it is returned with changed: false.
--dry-run without --id generates one and prints it as id; pass it to --yes.
--parent replies in a comment's thread.
Changes things: pass --dry-run to preview, --yes to apply.

Usage:
  linearctl comment create ISSUE [flags]

Examples:
  linearctl comment create ENG-123 --body "Fixed in #42" --dry-run --json
  git log -1 --format=%B | linearctl comment create ENG-123 --body-file - --id 5f1e… --yes

Flags:
      --body TEXT        the comment, Markdown TEXT
      --body-file PATH   read the comment from PATH (- for stdin)
      --dry-run          show what would change; change nothing
  -h, --help             help for create
      --id UUID          the new comment's UUID; required with --yes
      --parent ID        reply in the thread of comment ID
      --yes              apply the change
```

## linearctl comment delete

```
Delete a comment. A comment that is not there (already deleted, or never was)
is changed: false with found: false.
Changes things: pass --dry-run to preview, --yes to apply.

Usage:
  linearctl comment delete COMMENT [flags]

Examples:
  linearctl comment delete 5f1e… --dry-run
  linearctl comment delete 5f1e… --yes --json

Flags:
      --dry-run   show what would change; change nothing
  -h, --help      help for delete
      --yes       apply the change
```

## linearctl comment list

```
List an issue's comments, oldest first.

Fields: id, body, createdAt, url, user, parent

Usage:
  linearctl comment list ISSUE [flags]

Examples:
  linearctl comment list ENG-123 --json
  linearctl comment list ENG-123 --limit 0 --fields body,user --json

Flags:
      --cursor CURSOR   continue after CURSOR (nextCursor from the previous page)
      --fields FIELDS   return only these comma-separated FIELDS (see Fields above)
  -h, --help            help for list
      --limit N         show at most N items; 0 for all (default 50)
```

## linearctl comment update

```
Replace a comment's Markdown text. The same text again is changed: false.
Changes things: pass --dry-run to preview, --yes to apply.

Usage:
  linearctl comment update COMMENT [flags]

Examples:
  linearctl comment update 5f1e… --body-file note.md --dry-run --json
  linearctl comment update 5f1e… --body "Fixed in #43" --yes

Flags:
      --body TEXT        the new text, Markdown TEXT
      --body-file PATH   read the new text from PATH (- for stdin)
      --dry-run          show what would change; change nothing
  -h, --help             help for update
      --yes              apply the change
```
